description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key with SpaceNexus Research. Search the indexed SEC EDGAR filings wire for public space companies: form type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, S-1 and more), filing date, report date, 8-K item codes, accession number and sec.gov source link. Filter by company slug or ticker, form type and date.

company.description: Company profile slug or stock ticker, e.g. "rocket-lab" or "RKLB".

limit.description: How many filings to return (1 to 25).

offset.description: Filings to skip, for paging (0 to 10000).

since.description: Filings dated on or after this UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: sec_filings_search
title: SEC filings search
